summary: Iteration 18: Full testing of new features - Rebuy/Top-up system, Sit Out toggle, Admin Panel, Admin give-chips at table, Pot on oval felt, Leave Table. Backend 22/22 tests passed. Frontend all critical features verified via Playwright and screenshot review.

minor.issue: Dead code after return statement (lines 1045-1048 of server.py: game_rooms lookup and return _public_state unreachable). Cosmetic only, no functional impact.

integration_issues.issue: Pot in oval only shows when round !== 'waiting' AND total > 0 — verified by code review and design. Couldn't auto-test pot display live (game start over WS in test didn't produce an active round in time), but pot position is confirmed in oval by code and 'no pot in top bar' check passed.
